title: Calculate field values and format strings live
description: Automatically calculate prices, format reference codes, and transform field values in real time without custom JavaScript functions.
problem: You want live form calculations, dynamic pricing, or auto-slug generation that syncs across environments and works in Dyrected Cloud without server-side function code.
summary: Use the when fluent builder to produce declarative, sandboxed JEXL expressions that calculate values live as editors type.
runtimeNotes: Uses declarative JEXL expressions with the when helper, compatible with both Cloud and self-hosted runtimes.
intents: build reactive form transforms that survive Cloud schema sync
compute field values without writing raw JavaScript functions
calculate status-based pricing or conditional totals declaratively
format reference codes or IDs from sibling inputs in real-time
